text:
ana: Heads up team — publishing final internal plan for two billing features rolling out 2026-06-01: 1) Monthly spend caps (org-level) + optional auto-topup, 2) Updated free-tier & throttling for free accounts. Will notify customers next week.

devon: Summary please? I need bullets for finance deck.

ana: Quick bullets: - Monthly spend caps let org admins set a hard cap; when hit, API keys will either be blocked or auto-topup (charge saved card) depending on setting. - Auto-topup options: fixed increment or percentage of cap, configurable per org. - Free-tier credit reduced from $100 -> $50 for new signups; existing free credits remain for now. - Free accounts get lower steady concurrency (60 RPM) and stricter burst windows; paid accounts unaffected. - Invoices will indicate 'cap_action' when topups occur.

mira: How will blocking behave for integrated customers? Many use server-to-server keys.

ana???: (typo)

ops-bot: FYI: cap-enforcer v1.0 will be deployed 2026-05-28 02:00 UTC to primary region. Small migration of quota state expected. Monitoring: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/cap-101.

billing-bot: Implementation notes -> webhook event `billing.cap_reached` will be emitted with fields: org_id, cap_value, action_taken (blocked | topup). Email templates queued.

devon: Will auto-topup create disputes risk? Need billing dispute flow doc link.

legal-bot: Policy: auto-topup requires explicit admin opt-in and stored payment method; charge receipts will include clear descriptor. Legal sign-off on email wording required.

mira: Can admins set a soft-warning threshold? e.g., warn at 90%.

ana???: (still typo)

ana — seems glitchy

ana is not in participants — ignore

samir: Add a webhook warning at 80% (quota) and a separate `billing.cap_warning` at the org level at configured percentage (default 90%).

devon: Need CSV export of cap actions for reconciliation.

billing-bot: Will add `cap_action` rows to monthly invoice CSV: timestamp, org_id, action, amount.

mira: For Dedicated/Private: will we auto-enforce caps? Contracts may have custom billing.

ana???: (again)

ops-bot: (system noise)

mira: Ignore noise.

ana: sorry accidental paste — all good.

ana (real): Dedicated customers: caps are available but disabled by default; PMs will coordinate any contract updates. Private customers: feature available for on-prem but requires local billing connector.

devon: What's rollout plan for customer comms?

ana: Plan: - 2026-05-05: FAQ + console banner copy to legal & CS - 2026-05-12: staged email sends (high-touch customers first) - 2026-05-20: console banner public - 2026-06-01: enforcement date.

samir: Engineering notes: new DB table `org_billing_caps`, API endpoints for admin settings, events: `billing.cap_set`, `billing.cap_reached`, `billing.cap_topup`. Console will show projected monthly spend w/ cap overlay.

mira: Request: expose a read-only endpoint for internal audit to list topup transactions.

billing-bot: Noted. Add `audit.topup_list` to admin API.

devon: Please include migration plan for existing promo credits so we don't accidentally apply caps to historical credits.

ana: We'll exempt legacy promo buckets by default; migration job will tag them `legacy_exempt`.

legal-bot: Approved email subject suggestion: "Important: New spend caps & auto-topup options — action may be required".

ana: Thanks — I'll circulate final templates tomorrow and schedule a quick 30m sync for PM/CS/Legal. :thumbsup:

mira: ack.

billing-bot: Customer notice queued for staging send 2026-05-06T09:00:00Z.
